transcript_only_text:
There  are  only  four  paths  to  becoming 
 ultra-wealthy.  Number  one,  you  bet  other 
 people's  money  on  other  people's 
 businesses.  This  is  what  fund  managers 
 do.  Number  two,  you  bet  your  money  on 
 other  people's  businesses.  That's 
 investing.  Third,  you  bet  other  people's 
 money  on  your  business.  That's  raising 
 funds.  Fourth,  you  bet  your  money  on 
 your  own  business,  and  that's 
 bootstrapping.
